title: Clearer item creation, safer drafts
lede: Choose tracking by the gear you have, enter details reliably, and confirm before clearing a draft.

changes.was: Draft tracking ran during input capture and could reset text before its change handler read it. Reproduced in the authenticated preview.
changes.now: Both forms record draft changes after field handlers have accepted input.

changes.was: Changing tracking style could discard entered details immediately.
changes.now: An edited draft requires Clear draft and switch. Keep editing preserves values; unchanged choices remain quick.

changes.was: Technical tracking badges and forced focus into the form.
changes.now: Visible examples, responsive cards, keyboard navigation within the choices, and announced footer progress.

verification: Authenticated isolated branch preview: text entry, cancel preservation, and confirmed switch passed; zero browser runtime errors; no inventory saved.
Chromium fixtures at 1280, 768, and 390 pixels: draft preservation, confirmed reset, family-to-family reset, keyboard selection, and no horizontal overflow passed.
Final npm run build:app passed; one pre-existing unused-variable warning in Sidebar.tsx.
Docs verification and git diff --check passed.
notes: No commit or deployment. Existing unrelated workspace changes were preserved.
Fixture baseline snapshots include the three original creation files; other shared components and styles are the same for both captures.
See results.json and authenticated-results.json for interaction results. Confirmation captures are saved separately as confirm-*.png.
